research_rationale:
basis_pattern: original_plus_bounded_search. EO 12883 (signed 1993-11-29; 58 FR 63281; official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12883.txt, read in full; the text layer shows the order on Federal Register page 63281) amends section 2 of EO 12748 by adding subsection (c), which authorizes and designates the President's Pay Agent to exercise the President's authority under 5 U.S.C. 5304(h) over the extension of locality-based comparability payments to certain categories of positions, and makes the order effective immediately. Identity: heading, title and date agree with the register row. The dossier inventory omitted the authority recital, so I replaced it with three clauses (inventory override). Own terms: no end date or condition. Later instruments: EO 13106 section 8 (signed 1998-12-07; 63 FR 68152, held Federal Register text) amends section 2(c) of EO 12748 by changing the citation 5304(h) to 5304(g)-(h); it changes a citation and leaves the designation in force (strike-and-insert ruling of 2026-10-21: the clause continues, amended). EO 13415 section 2(a) (signed 2006-12-01; 71 FR 70641, held text) revokes sections 3 and 6 of EO 12748 and renumbers its later sections; it does not mention section 2, so it neither revokes nor amends the subsection EO 12883 added; it is addressed here because the U.S. Code status line for EO 12748 names it. A search of held order texts for the number 12883 finds only the order's own copy, EO 13106, EO 13415 and CFR authority lines. Current law: the U.S. Code (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; laws of 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 not reflected) prints EO 12748 under 5 U.S.C. 5301 note as amended by EO 12883, and its printed section 2(c) reads as the amended subsection, designating the Pay Agent under 5 U.S.C. 5304(g)-(h) (jobs/current-law/output/USC_EO_NOTES.jsonl); 5 CFR part 531 (GovInfo eCFR bulk copy amended through 2026-10-29; the lead is not confirmed at the cutoff by the point-in-time search) lists E.O. 12883, 58 FR 63281, and E.O. 13106 among the sources of its authority, which also cites 5 U.S.C. 5304. The authority statute named in the order, 5 U.S.C. 5304, is thus still in the Code and cited as authority for current regulations; its own text is not held. The three selected machine searches were read with their coverage notes; none carries a coverage warning and none records a revocation or supersession of EO 12883.
